highlighter.title: Highlighter

boardmarker.description: Capture ideas the moment they appear. Clear, vivid writing for classrooms and meetings without breaking the flow.

permanent.title: Permanent Marker
permanent.description: Mark clearly on a variety of surfaces when it matters. One click provides quick and reliable marking.

namepen.title: Name Pen

signpen.title: Sign Pen

coloring.title: Coloring / Brush

industrial.title: Industrial Marker
industrial.description: Clear, dependable marking for demanding work environments, designed for quick use and confident results.

ballpoint.title: Ballpoint Pen
ballpoint.description: Write down everyday thoughts with smooth, steady ink flow and a comfortable writing experience.

pencil.title: Mechanical Pencil
pencil.description: From quick notes to detailed drawings, enjoy a stable grip and precise control for every line.

justclick.description: JUSTCLICK is designed for instant one-handed use without the need to open or close a cap. Built around natural hand movements, it helps keep your creative and everyday tasks flowing.

bamboo.description: Combining creative expression and comfort, BAMBOO dual-tip markers are inspired by the natural elegance of bamboo. Flexible tips support writing, illustration, and coloring.

starflo.description: STARFLO 3C reimagines the classic three-color ballpoint pen with distinctive styling. Its slim body and hybrid ink deliver a comfortable writing experience and enjoyable color selection.

easyfluid.description: EASYFLUID introduces smoother, more consistent writing through low-viscosity hybrid ink, designed for comfort across everyday writing situations.
